name: print-social-orange-fast-food-social-set-arabic
title: Orange fast-food social set with Arabic calligraphic headline
whatItIs: A portfolio thumbnail of a restaurant's social posts. Eight squares in saturated orange feature burgers, wraps, and figures in traditional Gulf dress, with a large white Arabic script title in the middle.
whatItMeans: Appetising, warm and energetic; the single orange makes the whole set feel like one brand.
techniques: Choose one saturated brand colour and tint every post with it.
Repeat the hero product in large outsized type or stacked repeats behind it.
Blend photos of people with product for a local, friendly voice.
Place a big calligraphic title between two rows to label the collection.

vocabulary.definition: Filling the whole composition with one brand colour.
Repeating a word or object in layers for emphasis.
A decorative, fluid Arabic headline style.
A collage of many posts used as a cover.
